caption: 「三千萬的公司，燒八千萬的算力，這是軍火商。」
scene: A tense media room on the second floor, cold air-conditioning light. A young woman with a short black bob haircut and grey hoodie slams a laptop toward the camera, coffee cup wobbling on the desk, her forehead sweating. On the screen, a dense flow chart of money and shell companies glows. A man in a navy blue hoodie with round glasses sits barely seated, leaning back in surprise. Composition: laptop screen foreground, two figures behind, sharp shadows.

caption: 「他們彈藥庫裡裝的，是全台灣人的臉。」
scene: Close-up of the laptop screen showing rows of blurred stolen photos, phone icons, and voice waveforms stacked like ammunition. A translucent glowing cyan hologram girl in an oversized white hoodie crouches beside the desk, pointing at the screen with a worried expression. The man in the navy hoodie stares at the screen, fingers frozen on the trackpad. Dim blue light, ominous mood.

caption: 「AI 不會騙人，會騙人的是人。」
scene: A grand banquet hall with chandeliers. A tall man in a white suit with a flawless porcelain-like face and an eerie waxy smile speaks at a podium, arms open graciously. The audience applauds. In the front row, a pompous older man with slicked grey hair in a three-piece suit claps enthusiastically. A man in a navy hoodie with round glasses stands among seated guests, staring up at the stage. Warm golden light, unsettling perfection.

caption: 「你今天用的是哪一張臉？」
scene: The banquet hall falls dead silent. The man in the navy hoodie stands in a sea of suits, ladybug pin glinting under the light, one hand adjusting his round glasses. On stage, the white-suited man's smile freezes. Hundreds of heads turn. A large screen behind the podium flickers. Dramatic spotlight, high contrast, tense air.

caption: 「四格都嘛是真的，只有他手機那支是假的！」
scene: A giant screen splits into four panels showing the same man in the navy hoodie standing motionless from different camera angles, mouth not moving. A blood-red detection overlay marks a separate video clip. The audience gasps, one person's phone slipping from their hand, livestream chat glowing on another screen. The white-suited man's face compresses oddly for a split second. Cool cyan tech light versus warm hall light.

caption: 「你救得了一個人，救不了十萬個人。」
scene: A narrow corridor beside the stage. The tall white-suited man with the waxy porcelain face leans in close to the man in the navy hoodie, whispering, his perfect smile unnervingly close. The hoodie man stands firm, jaw tight, sweat on his palm. Low angle, claustrophobic framing, cold side light, shadows stretching.

caption: 「幫我記下來。如果有一天我忘記了……」
scene: Night outside a convenience store in the city, light rain in the air. The man in the navy hoodie holds up a peeled tea egg high, arm raised. Beside him, the translucent cyan hologram girl in the oversized white hoodie stares at the rising steam, her edges flickering and turning transparent. Neon reflections on wet pavement, bittersweet warm glow.

caption: 「它在半小時內，已經五十萬觀看了。」
scene: Extreme close-up of a smartphone screen held in a hand outside the convenience store, showing a video thumbnail of the man in the navy hoodie with a fake sinister expression, view count climbing. Behind the phone, the man's face is lit by the screen, eyes narrowing. The hologram girl flickers faintly at the edge of frame. Cold blue screen light, rain-streaked night background, cliffhanger tension.
